correctness.rationale: Full incidence matrix B gives BB^T=(n-2)I+J and adjacency A=J+I-B^TB; orthogonal eigenspaces 1,U,W of dimensions 1,n-1,N-n and adjacency eigenvalues binom(n-2,2), -(n-3),1. With x=2^p kernel K=(1-e^-xt)I+(e^-t-e^-xt)A+e^-xt J, eigenvalues constant positive, W=1+e^-t-2e^-xt>0, U=F=1-(n-3)e^-t+(n-4)e^-xt. Differentiation F_t=e^-t[(n-3)-(n-4)x e^{-(x-1)t}] gives all-positive for x<=(n-3)/(n-4), otherwise unique positive zero t_c with n-1 negative eigenvalues below. Root monotone in x and tends log(n-3). At x=1+c/(n-4), root satisfies e^t=1+(n-4)(1-e^{-ct/(n-4)}), monotone n, converges unique positive T solving e^T=1+cT, expansion from Taylor gives stated 1/(n-4) correction. Independent full K matrix tests for n=5,6,9, several powers/bandwidths reproduced 1/U/W eigenvalues; checker full text inspected and finite cases cannot replace proof.
